configExceptions.Cr: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 4s¹ 3d⁵. Classic exception: a half‑filled d subshell (d⁵) with one 4s electron is more stable. The last electron completing d⁵ occupies 3d. The shell‑by‑shell picture (n=3 → 13 e⁻; n=4 → 1 e⁻) reflects this anomaly.
configExceptions.Mo: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 5s¹ 4d⁵ — the same Cr‑type exception: half‑filled d⁵ with 5s¹. The last electron completing 4d⁵ is on 4d.
configExceptions.Cu: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 4s¹ 3d¹⁰ — the 4s subshell is written before 3d. The electron that completes filled 3d¹⁰ occupies 3d (differentiating electron for group). Shell distribution (n=3 → 18 e⁻; n=4 → 1 e⁻) reflects the exception: one 4s electron participates in forming stable 3d¹⁰.
configExceptions.Ag: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 5s¹ 4d¹⁰ — same type of exception as copper: filled 4d¹⁰ with 5s¹. The last electron completing 4d¹⁰ occupies 4d.
configExceptions.Au: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 6s¹ 4f¹⁴ 5d¹⁰ (Madelung order). Exception like Ag/Cu: filled 5d¹⁰ with 6s¹. The last electron completing 5d¹⁰ occupies 5d.
configExceptions.Nb: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 5s¹ 4d⁴. Exception (ns¹ (n−1)d^x): enhanced stability via the d‑subshell arrangement and a single electron on s. The last electron in Aufbau order is on subshell d.
configExceptions.Ru: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 5s¹ 4d⁷. Exception versus “ideal” filling; textbooks often treat valence electrons on 4d as well — see quantum numbers below.
configExceptions.Rh: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 5s¹ 4d⁸. Similar exception to other 4d metals: one 5s electron and a particular 4d arrangement; last Aufbau‑order electron sits on subshell d.
configExceptions.Pt: Standard (Aufbau) notation: 6s¹ 4f¹⁴ 5d⁹. Incomplete 5d with 6s¹; the electron completing the 5d build‑up occupies 5d (matching the quantum numbers).
configExceptions.Pd: Major exception: [Kr] 4d¹⁰ — without 5s electrons. A filled 4d subshell is more stable than the 5s² alternative; electron counts by shell reflect absent 5s electrons.

quantumFoot.CrMoSuffix: — for ${name}, the last electron occupying d subshell toward d⁵ configuration is treated as originating from d (the parameters below correspond to this d electron).
quantumFoot.CuAgAuSuffix: — for ${name}, the electron that completes filled d¹⁰ occupies d (these parameters correspond to this electron).
quantumFoot.NbRuRhSuffix: — unusual configuration; the last electron filled in Aufbau order is placed on subshell d (see note above).
quantumFoot.PtSuffix: — for Pt, the last electron completing subshell 5d sits in 5d (parameters match this electron).
quantumFoot.PdSuffix: — Pd has no 5s electrons; parameters correspond to the last electron in subshell 4d.
